name: WeVisOne-VL 2B — text-prompted image segmentation
title: Cut out a named thing from a picture
summary: Give it a picture and type the name of something in it; you get that thing cut out on a transparent background, its black-and-white matte, and the picture with a box around each one it found.
description:
Cut something out of a picture by naming it. WeVisOne-VL, a small vision-language model built into ComfyUI since 0.45, finds what your words name and answers with a box and an alpha matte for each one; this card saves three pictures: the cut-out (the source with everything else transparent, a PNG), the matte (white where the thing is), and the source with the boxes drawn, so you can see what it understood.

Use a short noun phrase ("human", "the red car", "chair"): a full sentence makes it ramble. Every instance it finds is cut out together. Experimental.
author: Template - ComfyUI
